references.role: approved Covenant creature anatomy, palette and style

input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted game character ANIMATION SHEET on uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Reference-1.png is the exact character identity and equipment reference. Reference-2.png is the APPROVED COVENANT CREATURE SOURCE, the authority for anatomy, palette and painting style. Use BOTH references visually. Match its lighter stylized painted values and simple sculpted shapes exactly; do not darken into realistic horror, add photoreal skin or fur, or add black shadows. Reference-1 is an A10 master or a crop of that approved source. Generate the requested anatomical view even if the reference is a rear view. This is an ANIMAL ONLY. No human body, no clothes, no weapon or staff, no hands. Keep its exact creature anatomy. Four moth wings, one thorax and two antennae. Reaction bends thorax and sweeps wings; collapse folds intact wings low against the ground. No human limbs. For ALL poses the camera sees BACK surfaces. Keep head and torso aimed upper-right away from viewer. Never turn to face the viewer. Raw magical oversized moth, four ragged triangular midnight-blue wings, pale silver wing veins and moonlike empty markings, small dark segmented body and fine antennae, restrained lilac wisps. Clear wing silhouette, no human face. REAR-RIGHT three-quarter view, head and torso facing diagonally AWAY from viewer and toward image RIGHT, back surfaces visible. Maintain this anatomical view for every pose, including resting body; do not rotate a flat upright sprite. Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic, not eye-level. Exactly FOUR columns by THREE rows, TWELVE complete poses. First six ATTACK: hover ready, wings gather, thorax draws back, all four wings sweep forward in a buffet, wings counter-sweep, hover ready. Last six DEFENSE: Six resistance poses: ready, lower body braces, forelimbs plant or moth wings fold forward, body withstands force, small effort variation, steady braced hold. No injury or collapse, no shield object or magic effect added to an animal.All complete bodies same anatomical scale, very wide empty magenta gutters. No labels, no text, no anatomy outside its cell. No falling or resting poses. Each equal cell contains ONE entire body at IDENTICAL anatomical scale. Each body and all equipment fit within middle 60% of the cell, including lying poses. Wide completely empty magenta gutters. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only.

arguments.Prompt:
A 4x3 grid animation sprite sheet containing exactly 12 discrete sequential animation poses of the Hush Moth creature from Reference-1.png and Reference-2.png on a solid uniform vivid pure magenta #FF00FF background.

Creature anatomy & appearance:
Oversized magical hush moth insect creature. Four ragged triangular midnight-blue / slate-blue wings with silver veins and glowing pale crescent moon-like markings on wing surfaces, dark segmented moth abdomen and fuzzy dark slate thorax, feathery dark antennae, subtle faint pale lilac wisps around body edges. Pure animal creature only, no humanoid features, no clothes, no weapons. Hand-painted 2D digital dark fantasy game art style matching Reference-2.png with clean sculpted volumes, painted highlights, and crisp silhouettes.

Angle & Perspective:
All 12 poses are shown from a consistent elevated 55-degree orthographic perspective in REAR-RIGHT three-quarter view (northeast isometric angle). The creature's head and body point diagonally up and away toward the upper-right (facing away from the viewer), showing dorsal / back surfaces, dorsal wing planes, and back of thorax in all poses. Never facing the camera.

Grid Layout (4 columns by 3 rows = 12 poses):
Organized in a strict invisible 4-column by 3-row grid with wide, completely empty vivid magenta #FF00FF gutters between each sprite. Each sprite is fully isolated in its cell, fitting entirely within the central 60% of its cell area. No sprite touches another or crosses cell boundaries. No panel lines, no borders, no text, no numbers, no floor, no background elements.

Sequence of 12 poses:
Top row (Poses 1 to 4):
- Pose 1: Attack Hover Ready - moth hovering in place, four wings spread wide in rear-right dorsal view.
- Pose 2: Attack Wings Gather - moth rearing slightly, wings pulled upward and back gathering energy.
- Pose 3: Attack Thorax Draws Back - thorax and abdomen curled back tightly, wings coiled high.
- Pose 4: Attack Wing Buffet Sweep - all four wings violently swept forward and downward in a powerful air strike.

Middle row (Poses 5 to 8):
- Pose 5: Attack Counter-Sweep - wings finishing follow-through stroke, snapping back outwards.
- Pose 6: Attack Hover Recovery - returning smoothly to neutral hover stance.
- Pose 7: Defense Neutral Ready - wings tensed, hovering close and vigilant.
- Pose 8: Defense Lower Body Braces - abdomen tucks in, legs tense, body shifts lower to absorb impact.

Bottom row (Poses 9 to 12):
- Pose 9: Defense Wings Fold Forward - wings shielding around thorax, folding forward to block.
- Pose 10: Defense Withstand Force - moth firmly planted/buffeted, wings clamped forward resisting kinetic force.
- Pose 11: Defense Effort Variation - subtle strain, wings trembling against pressure, holding firm.
- Pose 12: Defense Steady Braced Hold - solid guarded defensive lock before recovering.

Identical scale across all 12 figures, painted digital 2D fantasy sprite sheet, uniform vivid magenta #FF00FF background.
